thread:
Alex: Heads-up — after the quota UI change landed this morning the telemetry sampling numbers in console don’t line up with SDK-reported counters. Looks like SDKs are sending a new field and the console tile is ignoring it. Anyone else seeing this?
Maria: Yep saw a spike in mismatched attributions around 11:12am. sampler_id in events is populated now and console still expects sampler_tag.
Sam: Interesting — which SDKs are sending sampler_id? We rolled the TS and Python clients last week.
Maria: TS 1.12.0 and Py 0.9.4 both include it (we added sampler_id for deterministic dedupe). Go hasn’t shipped that change.
Tia: Quick repro I grabbed from logs: 

```
POST /v1/telemetry
{ "client": "ts", "sampler_id": "dc-42", "quota_bucket": "ingest:prod", "tokens": 42 }
```

Console mapper code still looks for `sampler_tag`.
Oliver: That’s a mapping/compat bug. Two options: 1) treat sampler_id as alias for sampler_tag in console ingestion layer, 2) ask SDKs to send legacy field until console migrates. I prefer console-side tolerant parsing.
Alex: Agreed — console-side fix is safer. But we also need a quick SDK patch to avoid double-counting during the change window. Can we do both?
Sam: I can put up a 1-line shim in the TS/py client that writes both fields for one release. That buys you time.
Maria: We should also update the quota dashboard tests — the sampling counts unit test is hard-coded to sampler_tag. I’ll open a follow-up PR.
Tia: PR idea: console ingestion should accept `sampler_tag || sampler_id` and normalize to `sampler_tag` internally. Add a deprecation warning to logs when sampler_id is used.
Oliver: Also check telemetry sampling telemetry itself — telemetry recursive hell if we log deprecations too loudly. Add a rate limit on the warning (1/second per instance).
DevBot: CI run queued for alex/console-sampler-alias (#9876) — sha: a1b2c3.
Alex: Thanks. Quick rollout plan: console patch to ingestion (canary to us-east-1) today, leave backward compatibility on for 2 weeks. SDKs publish a minor release that writes both fields for one release cycle, then remove legacy field in next major.
Sam: For clarity — TS: put in 1.12.1 that duplicates sampler_tag = sampler_id; Py: 0.9.5. I’ll add a changelog note and compatibility blurb.
Maria: Tests I’ll update: quota tile e2e + unit tests for ingestion mapping. Also add a small smoke check that simulates both field shapes so we don’t regress.
Tia: Can we add a console telemetry dashboard panel showing number of events where sampler_id != sampler_tag? That will help see clients that switch early.
Oliver: Good call. I’ll add a metric `telemetry.sampler_mismatch` and a Grafana panel on the quota dashboard.
Alex: Anything blocking the console canary?
Maria: Need a quick code review on the normalizer PR, and policy review for the deprecation notice text (legal likes ~30 day grace notes but we are giving 2 weeks).
Sam: I’ll coordinate SDK patch releases after PRs land. Also we should ping internal SDK consumers in #devex to watch for dual fields in logs.
Alex: Ok. Action items: Maria — open ingestion PR + update tests. Oliver — add mismatch metric + dashboard panel. Sam — create SDK patch releases duplicating field. Tia — add rate-limited deprecation log. Me — schedule canary for 3pm PST.
Maria: PR opened: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/9876 -> includes aliasing and unit tests.
DevBot: Deploy to canary (us-east-1) started for console-sampler-alias — build 2026.03.21-12:45 -> status: in-progress.
Sam: I pushed TS/py draft releases to npm/pypi staging (tags: rc/client-telemetry-dualfield). Please smoke.
Tia: Quick note for SDK maintainers: update your migration doc to show header/body shapes and mention dual-field release window.
Alex: Thanks all. If the canary looks clean we’ll flip in 4h then announce to customers and SDK slack threads.
Oliver: One more thing — check our billing pipeline: quota attribution uses sampler_tag for billing rollups. I’ll run a dry-run locally to ensure aliasing doesn’t change historical attribution.
Maria: Ran dry-run — aliasing normalized correctly for new events, historical data unchanged.
Alex: Great. Closing the loop once canary finishes. :thumbsup:
